_about: ThreadSmith garment presets. Each one adds hidden prompt text for its garment type, and tells ThreadSmith how to place and skin the result. Edit or add types here; ThreadSmith reads this file when it starts. {item} is the preset's 'item' text, {user} is what the user typed.

common.text_prompt: Ghost mannequin product photograph of {item}{user}. {openings}. Front view, centered, the whole item in frame, shown hollow as if worn by an invisible mannequin, no person, no mannequin, no hanger. Plain pure white background, soft even studio lighting, no shadows, sharp fabric detail.
common.edit_prompt: Turn the {item} from image 1 into a ghost mannequin product photograph{user}. {openings}. Front view, centered, the whole item in frame, shown hollow as if worn by an invisible mannequin, no person, no mannequin, no hanger. Plain pure white background, soft even studio lighting. Keep its colors, materials, patterns, logos and details exactly the same.
common.solid_text_prompt: Product photograph of {item}{user}. Front view, centered, the whole item in frame, no person. Plain pure white background, soft even studio lighting, no shadows, sharp detail.
common.solid_edit_prompt: Turn the {item} from image 1 into a product photograph{user}. Front view, centered, the whole item in frame, no person. Plain pure white background, soft even studio lighting. Keep its colors, materials, patterns, logos and details exactly the same.
common.negative: closed sleeves, sealed openings, person, face, hands, mannequin, hanger, multiple items, cropped, blurry, text, watermark

garments.label: Shirts

garments.label: Jackets
